answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 151082 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: What is the ruling of Tahmid and Tasmi after the ruku for women who prays on her own at home? Question: What is the ruling of Tahmid and Tasmi after the ruku for women who prays on her own at home? Answer ID: 151082 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 874/853/B=9/1438) After raising head from ruku, they will first say سمع الله لمن حمده and then say ربنا لك الحمد . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
